name: Amber Hour
summary: Sun-bleached deco towers and golden Haussmann stone, all graded through one amber gradient under a generated dusk sky. The hero is a full-screen evening that, in one unbroken camera move, pulls back into a postcard on the table and turns over to show a handwritten note. The work is calm, exact and built with care, and the light makes that visible without a single place name.
voice: Unhurried, exact, written by hand to one reader. Example: "I build software that pays for itself: apps, SaaS, and the quiet infrastructure AI agents run on."
motion: One continuous camera per page, slow and smoothed like a crane on a rig, and never a cut.
sound: Silent by default. The opt-in idea is one soft paper turn when the card flips over, and nothing else.
mark: An arch drawn with Bodoni stroke contrast whose crossbar is a horizon with the sun sitting on it, set beside a Bodoni wordmark with a small grotesk AS.
